_help: Fetch sound-feature tags. Edit freely: the names are your own labels for measured values, not trained models.
names: the words that select the tag in a search (+name). The first one is shown in columns and in Super search.
feature: centroid (spectral centre, Hz), low (share of energy below 150 Hz), flat (noisiness 0..1),
attack (time to peak, s), tail (tail from peak to -40 dB, s).
direction: -1 = the smallest values of the feature, 1 = the largest.
share: how large a part of the library counts as the tag (0.33 = a third).
Changes take effect immediately; nothing needs to be recalculated.
(The original Finnish keys tagit / nimet / piirre / suunta / osuus also work.)
